notes: Big fix: your spoof now survives leaving the app. iOS was suspending Wander in the background and reclaiming the connection that holds your fake location - so it snapped back to real, and on cellular it couldn't reconnect. Wander now stays awake for the whole session, so teleports and routes keep running with the app closed. Also: the tunnel no longer gets permanently stuck on 'reconnecting' after an Airplane Mode toggle, PoGo mode shows it's teleport-only so the joystick can't silently fail, gs-loc setup now supports Loon, Quantumult X and Stash (not just Shadowrocket), a new 'Check my setup' diagnostic pinpoints exactly why a spoof isn't working, the map keeps more of the screen, and 'Move here' no longer snaps the map.
